title: I vibecoded a german retro sci-fi Linux-Terminal-RPG-story game
author: frbnfr
selftext:
I've vibe-coded a role-playing game that also serves as a course on the Linux shell. It runs entirely in the browser.
It's not finished yet and is full of bugs, but it's already playable.

(sorry, so far it's only available in german) 

AI tools used:
Claude Opus 5.5 as the main developer
Gemini Argon 4 as the script writer and fact checker
Gemini tts for generating the voice tracks
Veo 3.1 + Kling 3 for generating the videos for cut scenes
MuseTalk running locally on my Mac Mini M2 for generating lipsync videos (which is lower quality than using AI video generation tools like Avatar 4, but far less expensive)
